title: tephroseris integrifolia subsp. karsiana
intro: Tephroseris integrifolia subsp. karsiana, commonly known as Karsian Mountain Everlasting, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tephroseris integrifolia subsp. karsiana include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as exhibiting antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
